title: HolyArrs plugin entry
description: One file per plugin in catalog/active/ or catalog/inactive/. The file name is the id plus .json.

id.description: Lowercase letters, digits and dashes, up to 64 characters. Matches the file name.

name.description: Shown on the Plugins page, 2 to 40 characters (the same limit as in holyarrs-plugin.json).

authors.description: GitHub user names of the people who made it.

repo.description: Public GitHub repo with the plugin source.

path.description: Folder inside the repo that holds the plugin, when it is not the repo root.

tag.description: Release tag the version is built from, like 1.0.0. That is the published version (a leading v is also accepted and dropped). A repo holding several plugins can tag <id>-v1.0.0.

commit.description: Full 40-character commit the tag points to. Later changes by the author are not picked up until this changes.

icon_url.description: Optional direct https link to your logo (PNG, JPEG, WebP or SVG, 16 to 4096 px a side, up to 2 MB; square at 256 x 256 or larger looks best). We copy it to plugins.holyarrs.com; the app never loads it from your link.

version.description: Optional. The plugin version, like 1.0.0; when given it must match the tag's version.

min_app_version.description: Oldest HolyArrs that may install it. 1.3.0 for new plugins.
